note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. alex.demo is an AD user of the lab domain; its password is typed by the owner in prepare and stored only as a protected Clixml on CON-CLI01, deleted in teardown. The Enter-PSSession demo is played with New-PSSession plus Invoke-Command because the recorder runs each command non-interactively.
prepare: foreach ($vm in 'CON-DC01', 'CON-SRV01', 'CON-SRV02') { $s = New-PSSession -VMName $vm -Credential $cred; Invoke-Command -Session $s { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep05 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Copy-Item -ToSession $s -Path (Get-Location).Path -Destination C:\lab\ep05 -Recurse -Force; Remove-PSSession $s }

if (-not (Invoke-Command -Session $cli { Test-Path "C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" })) { if (-not (Test-Path $msi)) { Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases/download/v$v/PowerShell-$v-win-x64.msi" -OutFile $msi }; Copy-Item -ToSession $cli -Path $msi -Destination C:\lab\pwsh.msi -Force; Invoke-Command -Session $cli { Start-Process msiexec.exe "/i C:\lab\pwsh.msi /quiet ADD_PATH=1 ENABLE_PSREMOTING=1" -Wait } }
$alexPw = Read-Host -AsSecureString "Password for alex.demo (owner types, never shown)"

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $alexPw { param($pw) if (-not (Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq 'alex.demo'")) { New-ADUser -Name "Alex Demo" -SamAccountName alex.demo -UserPrincipalName alex.demo@lab.contoso.com -AccountPassword $pw -Enabled $true } else { Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity alex.demo -Reset -NewPassword $pw; Enable-ADAccount -Identity alex.demo }; & C:\lab\ep05\setup\New-OpsJobIdentity.ps1 -HelpdeskUser alex.demo -CreateLabKdsRootKey }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV01 -Credential $cred { if (-not (Get-WindowsFeature Web-Server).Installed) { Install-WindowsFeature Web-Server | Out-Null }; $dir = "C:\inetpub\logs\LogFiles\W3SVC1"; New-Item -ItemType Directory $dir -Force | Out-Null; 1..30 | ForEach-Object { $f = Join-Path $dir ("u_ex2610{0:00}.log" -f $_); if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($f, (New-Object byte[] (2MB))) }; (Get-Item $f).LastWriteTime = (Get-Date).AddDays(-20 - $_) } }

screens.name: register
commands: Get-PSSessionConfiguration -Name Contoso.AppOps | Format-List Name, PSVersion, Permission

screens.name: task
screens.app: Task Scheduler on the CON-SRV02 console (VMConnect), then a PowerShell window
prepare: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV01 -Credential $cred { Start-Service W3SVC -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Stop-Service W3SVC }
steps: Before the shot (done in prepare): W3SVC is stopped on CON-SRV01 and the 60 MB of old IIS logs exist
VMConnect to CON-SRV02, signed in as the lab Administrator; open Task Scheduler (taskschd.msc)
Task Scheduler Library > Contoso > select OpsJob
General tab: show "When running the task, use the following user account: CONTOSO\gmsa-opsjob$"
Right-click OpsJob > Run; wait about a minute; press F5 to refresh
Show Last Run Result: The operation completed successfully. (0x0)
Open Windows PowerShell and run: Get-Content C:\OpsJob\logs\ops-*.jsonl -Tail 6

Show Health (W3SVC=Stopped, LogFolderMB about 60), Action RestartService W3SVC Succeeded, Action ClearLogs ("30 file(s), 60 MB freed") and RunEnd ExitCode 0; if the result is 0x1 keep it and show the Alert / Error lines
mask: VMConnect title bar ("<VM> on <laptop name>") and the laptop taskbar
the Windows user name in any window title

teardown: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { C:\lab\ep05\setup\Register-OpsJobTask.ps1 -Remove; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep05 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV01 -Credential $cred { Unregister-PSSessionConfiguration -Name Contoso.AppOps -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item "C:\Program Files\WindowsPowerShell\Modules\ContosoOps" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item C:\ProgramData\JEAConfiguration -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item C:\inetpub\logs\LogFiles\W3SVC1\u_ex2610*.log -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Uninstall-WindowsFeature Web-Server | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep05 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { & C:\lab\ep05\setup\New-OpsJobIdentity.ps1 -Remove; Remove-ADUser alex.demo -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep05 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# the KDS root key stays on purpose (forest-wide, reused by later episodes); restart CON-SRV01 if Uninstall-WindowsFeature asked for it
